The issuer shows weak short-term liquidity (current ratio of 0.53), which elevates refinancing/working-capital risk. However, profitability appears solid (EBIT of 1,360M on 6,020M revenue) and retained earnings are positive, while leverage is still high (total liabilities of 84,798M versus equity of 31,808M). Overall, this supports a **BB-** level credit profile.

DECISION: BB-
